articles.title: U.S. Senate puts off crypto Clarity Act for now as it focuses limited bandwidth elsewhere
articles.snippet: The majority leader is pursuing floor time for unrelated bills as the crypto industry waits for its policy effort to get its chance for votes.

articles.title: Kalshi, Polymarket win pause against Minnesota's prediction market ban
articles.snippet: A federal judge ruled that Minnesota's law criminalizing prediction markets would probably violate the federal Commodity Exchange Act.

articles.title: US judge temporarily blocks Minnesota prediction market ban
articles.snippet: The preliminary injunction allows Kalshi and Polymarket US to continue operating in Minnesota while the court considers their challenge to the state law.

articles.title: Kalshi, Polymarket Score Win as Judge Blocks Minnesota Prediction Market Ban—For Now
articles.snippet: The order turns on whether each contract counts as a swap under federal law, and the judge found that not every one does.

articles.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Will Arrive by September, Markets Predict
articles.snippet: Money is moving on a September bet for OpenAI’s next major model on both Polymarket and Myriad prediction markets.
